about: Four of the games' five shuffles become one, shuffleArray in apps/web/convex/gameShared.ts. It is the function that stood at games.ts:130-137, its eight lines unchanged but for `export`, under a comment that is new. The copies at emojiMatch.ts:155-162 and emojiBingo.ts:54-61 were that function letter for letter and are dropped. wordRush.ts:65-72 was the same function under the name `shuffle`, with other names for its two locals; it is dropped, and its four calls (lines 87, 88, 94 and 95) name shuffleArray. Each of the four files gains the import. Truth or Dare's loop (truthOrDare.ts:387-391) is not a function: it shuffles, in place, the array createGame has just built, and it is left as it stands. Nothing else in these files changes: no call is added, removed or moved, so every deal takes the draws it took, in the same order. Run from the repo root. Where each line stands: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/be-shuffle-shared.ranges.json --strict-indent (the first line of emojiMatch.ts, emojiBingo.ts and wordRush.ts is given as a range to its own file, which is how the tool is told to hold every other line of those files in its old order; the dropped lines are the `"new": null` entries). Every line counted once: node scripts/step6/line-account.mjs --base 11df99dc022c80e2d581e20c6fcec23f6c72587e --old apps/web/convex/games.ts --old apps/web/convex/emojiMatch.ts --old apps/web/convex/emojiBingo.ts --old apps/web/convex/wordRush.ts --allow scripts/step6/tables/be-shuffle-shared.json apps/web/convex/games.ts apps/web/convex/emojiMatch.ts apps/web/convex/emojiBingo.ts apps/web/convex/wordRush.ts apps/web/convex/gameShared.ts. Both read the tree they are run in, so they hold at the commit that made this change. Outside these tables: apps/web/convex/_generated/api.d.ts gains, by hand, the two lines a push would write, before those of games (`import type * as gameShared from "../gameShared.js";` and `gameShared: typeof gameShared;`), and apps/web/tests/convex/smoke.test.ts gains one import and one test, which holds the helper to the draws and the result of the copies it replaces. apps/convex/convex is the same files byte for byte: diff -r -x _generated -x tsconfig.json apps/web/convex apps/convex/convex.

apps/web/convex/gameShared.ts: * A shuffled copy of a list (Fisher-Yates); the list it is given is left as it was. Math.random is drawn once
* for every place but the first, from the last place down, so a list of n takes n - 1 draws. Tests replace
* Math.random with a fixed sequence to get a known board, deck or team split, and they depend on that order.
